Draw a stacked barplot from pre-computed counts

Source: R/stackedbarplotSCI.R
stackedbar_draw.Rd

Drawing back end shared by stackedbarplotSCI(), which counts raw data, and plotByVisit(), which reads the counts off a summaryByVisit() table.

Usage

stackedbar_draw(
  counts,
  n,
  visit = dimnames(counts)[[3]],
  group_names = NULL,
  group_names_short = NULL,
  scale = "percent",
  main = "",
  xlab = NULL,
  ylab = NULL,
  ylim = NULL,
  y_ticks = NULL,
  col = NULL,
  greyscale = FALSE,
  percent_labels = TRUE,
  col_percent = NULL,
  cex_percent = NULL,
  digits = 0,
  bar_width = NULL,
  cex_lab = 1,
  cex_axis = 1,
  cex_n_patients = 0.7,
  cex_groups = NULL,
  missing_seg = NULL,
  risk_table = FALSE,
  missing_nr = 0,
  rotate_labels = FALSE,
  mar_custom = NULL,
  xlab_line = NULL,
  ylab_line = 3,
  xlab_position = NULL,
  legend_position = "top",
  legend_title = NULL,
  legend_offset = c(0, 0),
  legend_cex = 1,
  legend_bty = "n",
  stat_footnote = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

counts

Numeric array of counts indexed by segment, group and time point, with dimnames.

n

Numeric group-by-time matrix of denominators for the percentages.

visit

Character vector of labels for the time points, one per column of the third dimension of counts.

group_names

A character vector containing the names of the groups to be displayed on the x-axis. The order must match levels(factor(data$group)). Default is NULL, which falls back to the group names found in the data.

group_names_short

A character vector containing short names or abbreviations for the groups, displayed beneath the bars and in the table of patient numbers. Optional. Defaults to group_names.

scale

The quantity on the y-axis. Either "percent" (the default) or "count".

main

Title of the plot. Defaults to "" (no title).

xlab

A label for the x-axis. Default is NULL, which uses "Time" if there are several time points, otherwise "Group".

ylab

A label for the y-axis. Default is NULL, which uses "Percentage of patients" or "Number of patients" depending on scale.

ylim

The y-axis limits of the plot as a numeric vector of length 2. Default is NULL, which spans 0 to 100 for percentages (more if the stacks exceed 100%) and 0 to the tallest stack for counts.

y_ticks

A numeric vector specifying the explicit tick positions on the y-axis. Default is NULL, which falls back to automatic tick placement.

col

A character vector of hex colors or color names to use for the stacked segments, bottom to top. Recycled if shorter than the number of segments. The missing-value segment (see missing) is always hatched and takes no color. Default is NULL, which applies the SCI color palette without its lightest shade.

greyscale

A logical toggle switch replacing the color palette by a sequential grey ramp, for print or black-and-white reproduction. Default is FALSE. Ignored if col is supplied.

percent_labels

A logical toggle switch enabling the percentage labels printed inside the segments. Default is TRUE. Empty segments, and segments too thin to hold a label, are left unlabelled.

col_percent

A character value giving the color of the percentage labels. Default is NULL, which picks black or white per segment, whichever contrasts better with the fill.

cex_percent

A numeric value specifying the font size of the percentage labels. Default is NULL, which sizes them to fit the width of the bars (at most 0.8). A number is used as given, even if labels then overflow narrow bars.

digits

A numeric value indicating the number of decimal places shown in the percentage labels. Default is 0.

bar_width

A numeric value giving the width of each bar in x-axis units. Default is NULL, which fills about 70% of each time point with the cluster of group bars.

cex_lab

A numeric value specifying the font size of the main axis labels. Default is 1.

cex_axis

A numeric value specifying the font size of the axis tick marks. Default is 1.

cex_n_patients

A numeric value specifying the font size of the table of patient numbers. Default is 0.7.

cex_groups

A numeric value specifying the font size of the group labels beneath the bars (several groups over time). Default is NULL, which uses cex_n_patients and shrinks the labels until they fit the bars. A number is used as given, even if long labels then overlap.

missing_seg

Index of the segment holding the missing values, drawn hatched instead of coloured. Default is NULL (none).

risk_table

A logical toggle switch enabling the table of patient numbers (the denominator of each bar) beneath the x-axis. Default is FALSE.

missing_nr

A numeric or character value indicating how zero-count patient sizes on the x-axis should be displayed. Default is 0. Can also be set to NA, which leaves the cell blank.

rotate_labels

A logical toggle switch rotating the x-axis tick labels by 90 degrees. Default is FALSE.

mar_custom

A numeric vector indicating the plot margins to be used in the form c(bottom, left, top, right). Default is NULL, which dynamically calculates spacing for the labels, the table of patient numbers and the legend.

xlab_line

A numeric value indicating the margin line offset for the x-axis label. Default is NULL, which calculates an adaptive offset.

ylab_line

A numeric value indicating the margin line offset for the y-axis label. Default is 3.0.

xlab_position

Horizontal position of the row labels of the table of patient numbers. Default is NULL, which aligns them just outside the plot region.

legend_position

Position of the legend box. "top" (the default) places it in one row above the bars, which keeps their full width; "right" places it outside the plot region to the right of the bars; "none" or NULL suppresses it. Other base R keywords (e.g., "topright") place it inside the plot region, and a numeric pair c(x, y) gives explicit coordinates. The margins are sized to the legend text.

legend_title

Title of the legend box. Default is NULL (no title).

legend_offset

A numeric vector of length 2 specifying an inset to nudge a keyword-placed legend. Default is c(0, 0).

legend_cex

A numeric value specifying the font and element scaling size inside the legend box. Default is 1.

legend_bty

The type of box border to be drawn around the legend. Allowed values are "n" (no border, the default) and "o" (standard box frame).

stat_footnote

The text of the footnote in the bottom-right corner, or NULL for none (the callers turn TRUE into their default text).

...

Further graphical parameters passed on to plot().

Value

Invisibly, a list with counts, n and percent.
